encoding.name: SQVB fixed-order binary v1
encoding.text: u32 byte length followed by strict UTF-8
encoding.bytes: u32 byte length followed by exact bytes
encoding.arrays: u32 element count followed by elements
encoding.parserRule: known type/version/enums only; exact EOF; no extension fields or alternate encodings
encoding.txidRule: 32 display-order bytes; raw transaction and PSBT bytes remain byte-exact
